answer.rationale: The incumbent will not reopen pricing, making renewal unlikely to meet the mandated 18% spend reduction. The prior low-cost vendor record is the most decision-critical evidence because it indicates sharply lower unit cost and fast onboarding, but it must be verified before relying on it given the 14-day expiry and 94% line utilization. A primary switch carries material delivery and qualification risk, so execution should be contingent on confirming current capacity, lead times, and transition readiness; renewal remains the delivery-risk fallback if those conditions cannot be established in time.
